_readme: Public on-chain addresses only — never secrets (see .gitignore note).
There is no 'memeToken' key any more. Two v1 vaults exist on mainnet and BOTH
have an immutable owner role (updater: 'None', verified 2026-08-21).
They are recorded below as tombstones so nothing re-adds them, and the deploy
script keys off 'memeTokenV2' so it can never reuse a dead deployment.

memeTokenV1Dead._note: PRODUCTION v1 — this is the pair the live game used, and the one holding the stranded XRD. Retired: its owner+admin badge sits in account_rdx12xgra93fqw4u0nmwhlu5rs7f5gvg807rstd54kxwwy2alhxz223v2x, whose key is held, so the vault's XRD is recoverable in principle with a proof of that badge; the badge and the XRD have not moved, and no recovery is planned (decided 2026-10-11). See docs/VAULT-V1-LOST.md.
memeTokenV1Dead._packageNote: packageAddress is truncated as read from the Gateway blueprint reference — re-read it in full before quoting it anywhere authoritative.

memeTokenV1Unused._note: An EARLIER v1 deploy that never carried traffic: 0 XRD, total_minted 0, and its MEME resource has zero supply. This block was what deploy-state.json recorded as 'memeToken' until 2026-08-21, which made the file disagree with the live env — the running game used memeTokenV1Dead's addresses, not these. Also an immutable owner role (updater: 'None').
